Install Configure Upgrade FAQ

Setting up the widget

Install

Run the installer and pick the widget folder. It takes about two minutes on most machines.

Configure

Open widget.toml and set the port to 8080 before the first start.

Upgrade

Stop the widget, install the new version over the old one, and start it again.

FAQ

The widget keeps its settings across upgrades.
